Engagement Package

Three Documents. Read In Order.

The package is split into three documents so each one can stand alone. The Proposal is the decision document and contains the signature block for the Discovery & Alignment engagement. The Scope of Work is the reference document with deliverables and methodology. The Phasing & Lead Times document covers sequencing and the hard external lead times (proposal validity, kickoff after PO/intake, payment terms), engagement durations themselves are agreed at each kickoff so we can match the library's pace.

Three Engagement Options

Discovery First. Then Choose.

Each engagement is priced standalone with no contingencies. Discovery & Alignment is the recommended starting point because it lets both sides confirm fit and produces a scoped recommendation for whichever Phase makes sense next.

Recommended Starting Point

Discovery & Alignment Engagement

Fixed-fee. Leadership conversations, technology inventory snapshot, decision-flow snapshot, and a Lay of the Land memo with three framed options for what Phase 1 should look like. Includes leadership readout. Stakeholder set, interview cadence, and delivery date all agreed at kickoff.

$24,500USD · Fixed Fee
Optional Continuation

Phase 1 · Operational Assessment

Fixed-fee. Stakeholder interviews, full process mapping, alignment scoring, future-state design, and a board-ready presentation. Answers the three questions in your RFQ: where things stand, how aligned roles and systems are, and what a practical future state looks like. Stakeholder set and delivery window matched to the library's calendar at kickoff.

$87,500USD · Fixed Fee
Optional Phase 2 · Path A

Implementation Roadmap Build

Fixed-fee. 24-month technology roadmap, governance & decision-making playbook, prioritized initiative briefs, and RFP-ready scopes for any major buys. Fixed scope, fixed deliverable. Sequencing and delivery window agreed at kickoff.

$165,000USD · Fixed Fee
Optional Phase 2 · Path B

Embedded Advisory Retainer

Monthly retainer. Weekly leadership office hours, monthly steering, quarterly business review, on-call advisory for staff on technology decisions. Initial term and renewal cadence agreed at engagement start.

$24,500USD · Per Month
